about: A started post-login activity mails the people it is due for a reminder to sign in, where the activity then asks them to do it. A scheduler job reads each running activity's people a slice at a time, about every {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, and mails only the people the activity is due for — never twice within the reminder interval, and never more than the activity's maximum. The mail's one link opens the sign-in page; it carries no credential. The rules each activity follows are its post-login profile's, on Directory → Policies.
noMail: No mail transport is configured in this realm, so a running post-login activity mails nobody. Set one up on Server configuration → Mail.
noActivity: No post-login profile in this realm has an activity switched on, so nobody is due one and a started activity would mail nobody. Turn one on in Directory → Policies.
reportLink: Who was mailed, and where each person stands: the postLoginProgress report
none: No post-login activity has been started in this realm.
numbers: every {interval, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, at most {max} per person, {perRun} people a run
done: {passes, plural, one {# pass} other {# passes}}, {read} read, {mailed} mailed, {refused} refused
groupsHint: Search for groups and pick one or more results to build the list. The activity mails the members of every group on the list, each person once; with no group, everybody in the realm.
noGroups: No group chosen: the activity reaches everybody in the realm.
findPlaceholder: part of a group's name or DN
groupsFull: {max} groups are chosen, the most one activity may name.
startNote: Mailing starts at the job's next run. A person who has done the activity, or whom the realm cannot ask, is not mailed.
readOnly: Starting, pausing and ending a post-login activity needs Admin Write.
